name: Tut Tut Vroom Vroom
storyline:
Explore maps packed with boosts, ramps, traps, checkpoints, loops, and obstacles! Survive the "Boulder Escape" mode, pull off your best drift combos in "Drift" mode, and reach the end of the obstacle courses in "Time Trial" mode!

A sandbox map is also available to test your car's suspension, different surfaces, and of course, the physics engine and collision mechanics.

Remember: don't touch the lava, don't hit the traffic cones and, above all, keep an eye on your fuel gauge!
summary:
Tut Tut Vroom Vroom is a fun and addictive low-poly racing game with sophisticated vehicle physics.

Explore six maps packed with boosts, ramps, traps, checkpoints, loops, and obstacles! Survive the "Boulder Escape" mode, pull off your best drift combos in "Drift" mode, and reach the end of the obstacle courses in "Time Trial" mode!

A sandbox map is also available to test your car's suspension, different surfaces, and of course, the physics engine and collision mechanics.

Remember: don't touch the lava, don't hit the traffic cones and, above all, keep an eye on your fuel gauge!
